description: Merge PDF files into one document. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

files.description: The PDFs to join, in the order their pages should appear in the result. Needs at least two, and no more than 30 in one request.

items.description: One PDF to include, with all of its pages.

data.description: This PDF's bytes, base64-encoded. A data: URL prefix is stripped.

name.description: Filename used to identify this PDF in the response's `sources` list and in any error message about it.

name: pdf_merge
title: Merge PDF
